description: This file defines functions, types, and constants related to hooks configuration, processing, and validation within the openclaw project. It handles resolving hook configurations, session keys, agent permissions, and message payload normalization.

methods.name: resolveHooksConfig
methods.description: Resolves and validates the hooks configuration from the provided OpenClawConfig object, returning a structured HooksConfigResolved object or null if hooks are disabled.

methods.name: extractHookToken
methods.description: Extracts the hook token from the Authorization header or x-openclaw-token header in an IncomingMessage.

methods.name: readJsonBody
methods.description: Reads and parses JSON body from an IncomingMessage with size limit and error handling.

methods.name: normalizeHookHeaders
methods.description: Normalizes headers from an IncomingMessage to a lowercase key-value object.

methods.name: normalizeWakePayload
methods.description: Validates and normalizes wake payload object, ensuring required fields are present.

methods.name: resolveHookChannel
methods.description: Resolves and validates the hook message channel from an unknown input.

methods.name: resolveHookDeliver
methods.description: Determines whether hook delivery is enabled based on the input.

methods.name: resolveHookIdempotencyKey
methods.description: Resolves the idempotency key from headers or payload.

methods.name: resolveHookTargetAgentId
methods.description: Resolves and validates the target agent ID based on hooks configuration and input agent ID.

methods.name: isHookAgentAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a given agent ID is allowed according to hooks policy.

methods.name: getHookAgentPolicyError
methods.description: Returns error message when agent ID is not allowed.

methods.name: getHookSessionKeyRequestPolicyError
methods.description: Returns error message when session key request is disabled.

methods.name: getHookSessionKeyPrefixError
methods.description: Returns error message when session key prefix validation fails.

methods.name: resolveHookSessionKey
methods.description: Resolves and validates the session key based on configuration, request, or generates a new one.

methods.name: normalizeHookDispatchSessionKey
methods.description: Normalizes and constructs a session key for dispatching to a target agent.

methods.name: normalizeAgentPayload
methods.description: Validates and normalizes the payload for a hook agent message.
